name: codeatlas
description: Tree-sitter code map, config/schema relationships and the SNIPE fix loop for large codebases, with navigator, sniper and reviewer agents.

guard_mode.title: Guard mode
guard_mode.description: default: deny built-in Grep/Glob, whole-file Read and in-declaration edits of indexed files and name the CodeAtlas call instead; search: only the search redirects; off: no guard.

auto_approve.title: Auto-approve read-only tools
auto_approve.description: Approve CodeAtlas's read-only tools without a permission prompt (edits, SNIPE state changes and test runs always ask).

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Serve the live dashboard on 127.0.0.1:8765 while the server runs.
